strategy.line: A name is the hardest thing to change later.
strategy.note: And the cheapest thing to get right now. We start from strategy — who you are for and what you stand for — so the name is inevitable, not just available. See what it costs →

faq.q: What does a brand naming agency do?
faq.a: A naming agency develops the name a company, product or service goes to market with — memorable, ownable, legally clear and strategically right. We handle the strategy, the candidates, the availability checks and the story behind the winner.

faq.q: What makes a good brand name?
faq.a: It is memorable, easy to say and spell, ownable in trademark and domain, and it means something true about you. A good name also has room to grow, so it still fits when you launch your second product.

faq.q: Do you check trademark and domain availability?
faq.a: Yes. We screen candidates for domain, trademark and social availability before anyone falls in love, so the name you choose is one you can actually own. For registration we work alongside your legal counsel.
A focused naming project runs one to a few weeks, depending on scope and how many stakeholders weigh in. You get a real timeline before we start.

faq.q: How much does brand naming cost?
faq.a: Naming can be a standalone project or part of a full identity. Our brand work starts at $280; naming-led engagements are quoted to scope. See the full pricing.

closing.note: Tell us about the company or product and who it is for. We will find the name it deserves.
